catches.catch: Installation priced at GBP 3,500 for 122.98 m2 of shopfront 3.5 metres tall - GBP 28.46 a square metre. The template INSTALLATION formula reads the product code, and DAD gives GBP 500 per element regardless of size. House CW labour at GBP 150/m2 is GBP 18,446.32. Corrected, the tender lands within GBP 2,797 of the independent benchmark Mary built ten days earlier with no supplier quote at all.

The LPS 1175 SR2 security doorset the drawing schedule requires on ED-06 was asked for in writing in our own RFQ of 23 July, and BSW's reply never mentions it. They quoted a standard commercial doorset - electric strike, electric latch, rectifier, closer - with no LPS 1175, SR2 or LPCB reference anywhere. Silence in answer to a direct request is not compliance, and a certified doorset cannot be substituted after award.

Solar control glass is not priced on any of the seven screens. All three types require a g-value of 0.5-0.6; BSW quoted plain laminated/toughened units with no coating named and no g-value stated. The supplier rate of GBP 374.61/m2 sits GBP 30/m2 below our own benchmark, and the gap is roughly the missing coating.

The trade bill and the architect's materials schedule both specify ALUPROF - the drawings were literally 'Issued to Aluprof' - and we are offering SMA Shopline with no non-compliance statement and no compliant bid alongside it, which the ITT expressly requires of a value-engineered alternative. Third alternative-system exposure this month after Technal/Modeal and Senior.

BSW put a non-compliance in writing and the tender does not carry it. Their covering email of 24 July reads: "we have met the u- and g- and acoustic value for glazing only, as these area commercial thermally broken shopfront products they are non rebated." The drawing schedule's U 1.0 and Rw 32 dB are element targets, not glass targets - so the supplier has told us the elements do not comply. Our proposal renders the whole thing as "Ug values noted between 1.0-1.1 W/m2K where quoted": true of the glass, silent on the element, the non-rebated frames and the acoustic.

Specification requires every external door to be 60 minute fire rated, including doors inside the curtain wall screens. Caught 3 days before the deadline against a budget that priced them as standard aluminium.

Quote excludes "Teleflex controls / wiring" while drawing A007 expressly requires all installation, core wire, conduit and fittings to be included - against a GBP 17,779.06 Teleflex charge with no supplier quote on file.
Proposal issued to the client still calls mastic an optional extra while the pricing document charges for it and for EPDM inside the total.
AOV smoke vents give 1.30 m2 geometric free area against the 1.5 m2 required - caught before order, with the supplier's own fix (1235 x 1583) identified.
Glass quoted is Coolite SKN175(ii), not the specified Pilkington Suncool Pro T 66/33, with the laminated and toughened panes apparently reversed - moving the solar control coating.

Glass order 46 panes short (+24 percent) caught before manufacture. CN Glass alternative approximately GBP 7,000 cheaper than Vetroseal for the same make-up - though on checking, that rate is a verbal confirmed by email, not a priced quotation.
Chapel folding doors (spec 3.15) missing from the supplier RFQ - confirmed as our scope on 27/07.
Missed portal RFQ discovered via a stage-ending reminder - not on the log, no folder. Since closed on instruction.
Fire-exit double doors quoted without the specified panic bar.
Supplier reply directly contradicts the triple-glazing spec.
Register-only benchmark landed within 6.3 percent of the manufacturer quote.
